:::{#thm-moments-low-order}
#### The first raw moment and the second central moment

If $\E{X^2} < \infty$, then the first [raw moment](#def-moment) of $X$ is $\E{X}$,
and the second [central moment](#def-central-moment) of $X$ is $\Var{X}$.

:::

::: proof

The first [raw moment](#def-moment) is $\E{X^1} = \E{X}$ by @def-moment.
The second [central moment](#def-central-moment) is $\E{[\devn(X)]^2}$ by @def-central-moment,
which is $\Var{X}$ by @def-variance.

:::
